analysis.analysis: The market is displaying classic signs of dealer gamma squeeze risk with deeply negative GEX at -$621M, meaning dealers are short gamma and will amplify any directional moves. The VIX at 19.74 with transitioning volatility regime suggests increasing uncertainty, while the CAG at 0.67 indicates bullish sentiment may be overextended. Five new large flow trades during this cycle likely represent institutional repositioning ahead of potential volatility expansion. The divergence between short-term bullish signals and longer-term neutral readings suggests the market is at an inflection point.
